Checkbox.summary: Checkbox control that toggles checked on click and fires OnChange; box and text visuals come from the theme

props.checked: Whether the box is checked, default true; copied into state.checked by New for the theme to draw
props.caption: Text to display, default "text"
props.textoffset: Offset of the text relative to the box, in pixels, default 0
props.boxsize: Box edge length in pixels, default 10
props.noFont: Skip automatic creation of the default font object, default false
props.OnChange: Callback table invoked by Toggle through CallListeners with the new checked state

Checkbox:New.desc: Construct a Checkbox and copy the initial checked value into state.checked

params.obj: Property table that overrides the defaults

Checkbox:Toggle.desc: Toggle the check state: first call OnChange with the negated value, then update checked/state.checked and Invalidate

Checkbox:DrawControl.desc: Draw the checkbox; this is an empty stub, the skin/theme overrides it

Checkbox:HitTest.desc: Hit test that always returns self, so the whole rectangle is clickable

Checkbox:MouseDown.desc: Toggle the state as soon as the mouse goes down, and return self to mark the event handled

fileDesc: Defines the Checkbox class: toggles checked, fires OnChange on change, and leaves the box look to the theme.
